claim: A study of undergraduate students at a rural South African university found that their LMS experiences were shaped by infrastructural limitations, digital literacy gaps and variation in faculty engagement.
quote: The findings revealed that while students identified the opportunity for learning flexibility and access through the LMS, their experience was primarily shaped by infrastructural limitations, gaps in digital literacy, and variation in the level of engagement by faculty.

claim: A comparative assessment of e-learning and m-learning adoption in South Africa distributed questionnaires among students at North-West University and Vaal University of Technology.
quote: In carrying out this research, we distributed questionnaires among students of the North-West University, South Africa in all the three (3) campuses and Vaal University of Technology (VUT), South Africa.

claim: A discursive study examined Moodle learning management system use in rural South African universities.
quote: This discursive study examined the use of the learning management system (LMS) Moodle in rural South African universities.

claim: A study of digital arts playroom use employed a survey-based quantitative design with data from 279 South African university students who had prior experience or exposure to the playroom.
quote: The study adopts a survey-based quantitative research design, utilizing data collected from 279 South African university students who have prior experience or exposure to the digital arts playroom.

claim: Among South African accounting students in one study, the majority viewed the learning value of an online simulation as more beneficial than traditional teaching methods regardless of ICT adoption profile, gender or population group.
quote: Despite the differences noted, the majority of students, irrespective of ICT adoption profiles, their gender or population groups agreed that the learning value of an online simulation was more beneficial than traditional teaching methods.
